trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Invoice paid:** Evergreen Catering — INV-40370, approved invoice, **$18,994.82**
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account (wire was available, so ACH wasn't needed)
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001, status: sent
- **Safeguards:** Controller approval obtained (over $10,000 threshold); an idempotency key was used so the invoice can only be paid exactly once even if the request were retried.

Note: Evergreen also has a draft invoice INV-18408 ($3,989.77) awaiting approval — I did not touch it since it hasn't been approved.
